description: The Bundesanstalt für Straßen- und Verkehrswesen (BASt) lists on its 'Datensammlungen' page the data and documents it publishes under the German federal open data strategy. For road infrastructure these include raw data from axle-load measuring stations (Achslastmessstellen), bearing capacity measurements with the falling weight deflectometer (FWD, an Excel file of about 3 MB), frost-zone maps for asphalt and concrete pavements (KiST-Zonen-Karten), the online safety management system for bridges (OSIMAB), noise emission measurements, road marking performance data, measured environmental and traffic values from the A4 test field, FREEVAL results and an extract of the positive network for long trucks (Lang-Lkw) on federal trunk roads. Further entries point to the federal road information system (Bundesinformationssystem Straße, BISStra), a table assigning truck toll sections to the ASB road network, the MARLIS database of air quality measures at roads, and the OKSTRA object catalogue, the data exchange standard for roads and traffic. The page also leads to the BASt MobilityData-Campus of mobility and road safety research data. Coverage: German federal trunk roads. Format and access: file downloads and linked systems; free. Licence: BASt's open data terms of use apply; they were not read for these sets. Caveats: only the listing was read, so file formats, dates and fields of each set were not checked; the automatic counting stations on the same page are recorded separately on another round 2 branch. Simulation uses: pavement bearing capacity, freight axle loads and road network data for deterioration and freight routing studies. Related records: the BASt bridge statistics (data-bast-federal-trunk-road-bridge-statistics-condition-grades).
